notes.title: New version! Bug fixes! Community love
notes.content:
Some users were experiencing the following issues, and they've since been fixed:

- Mac version not starting
- Ladders sometimes not transporting players to next area
- Falling into certain areas left players indefinitely falling into void

If you were experiencing any of these issues, feel free to give it another go!

Also thank you all for contacting us and letting us know about bugs. It's extremely helpful for us!

If you find any other problems, or would like to get ahold of us for any other reason, please don't hesitate to contact us via email rocketboatgame AT presentdaymedia DOT com or via our Facebook page fb.com/rocketboatgame

Also we've seen several of the playthroughs on YouTube and they have been so entertaining and informative! Can't wait to watch some more ːsteamhappyː
